metadataRaw.description:
Dr. Rowe shows how to fix WHOLE BODY muscle pain and tightness in a simple step-by-step guide. 

We're going to focus on getting rid of painful muscle knots, spams, and trigger points by using Dr. Rowe's go-to exercises. To keep it easy, we'll break it up and show how to do them on the neck, upper back, lower back, arms, and leg muscles. 

Each of these exercises work just a little bit differently, so go through them all and use what works best for you. 

As a bonus, these muscle pain relief exercises can be done AT HOME and can give instant muscle pain relief... even in as little as 30 SECONDS!

Watch now and get rid of muscle pain and tightness in seconds!
